items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: That's where I met Louis Silver.

ctx.x: What job was that? Well, sewing sacks. In other words, like the sugar would come in. Oh, okay. If a bag would break, you jump in the hole of the ship. And right away, you got a needle and brown thread, and you sew those sacks up real quick, and you break it. Oh, okay. So, that's what I started doing. And after I saved up enough money, and I went down Ramport Street there for a little while, and I started sewing clothes on the weekend when I wasn't working on the riverfront. That's where I met Louis Silver. And I…
Okay. So, when you got out, so when you, I mean out of high school you were kind of directionless. Yeah, right.
